about: What the Ernst dog did, per scene frame, measured from its own render (fixed camera: x_screen is the screen centre of the torso pixels of the engraved maquette; facing is +1 when the rendered head is on the door side of the rendered tail; posture from the rendered torso height). state is the score decision that drove the frame (copied, not measured). x_score is the score position.
camera: fixed orthographic plate camera, 168 px/m, threshold x=0 at screen x=400, pitch 18 deg

fields.head_below_back: rendered head centre at least 8 cm below the top of the back
fields.frac_in_frame: share of the dog pixels whose screen x lies inside the door opening
fields.z_min: m, the deepest rendered point of the dog (negative = past the facade plane, in the reveal)
